overview_description.description:
Patchwork is a premium flex office and white label serviced offices network in Paris, specializing in providing high-end, design-driven workspaces for large corporations and international companies establishing their headquarters in the city. With prestigious locations across Paris, Patchwork offers fully equipped private offices, meeting rooms, and collaborative spaces tailored to the needs of global enterprises. Our flexible office solutions come with premium services, including high-speed internet, concierge support, and event spaces, ensuring a seamless and professional work environment.

Beyond our flex office solutions, Patchwork also offers design & build services for major institutional property owners, focusing on office building restructuring, plug-and-play renovations, and creating cutting-edge work environments. Additionally, we provide facility and property management services, as well as third-party office space commercialization, helping landlords optimize and market their real estate assets. By fostering a vibrant and connected business community, we provide the ideal setting for global companies to establish a strong presence in Paris and drive their growth in the European market.

product.name: Private Offices
product.description: Private office spaces for teams ranging from 1 to 35 workstations, providing a secure and dedicated work environment.

product.name: Entire Floor Offices
product.description: Large office spaces accommodating 35 to 300 workstations, offering open and adaptable layouts for growing companies.

product.name: Whole Building Offices
product.description: Office spaces occupying entire buildings starting from 200 workstations, designed for large enterprises or departments requiring customized environments.

product.name: Meeting Rooms
product.description: Rooms available for hourly or daily rental, equipped with audiovisual technology and configurable for various group sizes.

product.name: Event Spaces and Conference Centers
product.description: Modular event venues for professional and private events, supporting up to 190 participants with full technical and catering services.

product.name: Design & Build Services
product.description: Comprehensive office design and build solutions including space planning, interior architecture, and turnkey fit-outs.
